statusHistory.reason: Record created during demo data installation

risk.advice: Review the PM interval and confirm consumables/spares are available.

contributing: 1 fault report(s) in the last 12 months
factors.label: Failure frequency
factors.basis: Fault reports on this item in the last 365 days.

factors.label: Severity of past faults
factors.basis: Worst severity recorded, plus any critical fault in the last 180 days.

contributing: Last PM 177 day(s) ago (5.8 months), interval 180 day(s)
factors.label: Preventive maintenance lag
factors.basis: Time since the last PM measured against the configured interval.

factors.label: Current fault exposure
factors.basis: Open fault reports right now, by severity and stage.

factors.advice: Plan end-of-life review: repair-vs-replace assessment with training impact.
factors.label: Age and warranty
factors.basis: Years in service since acquisition, and warranty status.

factors.label: Recent repair activity
factors.basis: Time since the last completed repair (repeats soon after a fix imply an unresolved cause).

contributing: Not usable for 0.1% of the last 180 days
factors.label: Downtime share
factors.basis: Proportion of the last 180 days the item was not usable.

risk.disclaimer: Decision-support indicator only. It ranks maintenance attention using this department’s own history; it does not certify that equipment is safe, does not diagnose faults, and does not replace inspection by a qualified biomedical engineer.

rows.title: Screen freezes during demo
rows.description: The touchscreen freezes about two minutes into a demo and needs a power cycle every time.

rows.title: NIBP over-reads by ~20 mmHg
rows.description: Automated cuff readings sit about 20 mmHg above the manual reference on the same arm.

rows.title: Air-in-line false alarm
rows.description: Air detector triggers constantly with a bubble-free line.

rows.title: Touch screen unresponsive on left half
rows.description: The touch panel ignores input on the left third, so patient data cannot be entered.

rows.title: Transducer cable breaks image
rows.description: Image disappears unless the probe cable is held at an angle.

rows.title: Image blurred at 40×
rows.description: One objective gives a permanently soft image at high power; the fine focus cannot recover it.
